_comment: Generated by scripts/build_patch_data.py from the cached EA page in data/patch-source/. 'text' is EA's exact wording and must stay that way - scripts/build_patch_data.py --check re-reads EA's page and fails if any bullet is missing or altered. 'section' and 'items' are meant to be hand-corrected and are not overwritten by --check.

entries.text: New Content Arrives : Operation Augur arrives alongside the LTV, the Ripper 14”, and a new Battle Pass Bonus Path that expands the rewards available during the fight for survival.
heading: Major Updates for 1.2.3.0

entries.text: Progression Feels More Rewarding : Weapon XP and Vehicle XP are now earned through active use alongside kills and assists, XP rates have been increased slightly across Multiplayer, and Battle Royale and Gauntlet progression now place more weight on time spent in a match, with Battle Royale also awarding higher scores for kills and damage assists.
heading: Major Updates for 1.2.3.0

entries.text: Battle Royale and Gauntlet Improvements : Loot flow has been updated, Strike Packages and Armour Plate availability have been rebalanced, and a wider pass on challenge tracking, objective progression, and End of Round presentation helps both modes play and reward more consistently.
heading: Major Updates for 1.2.3.0

entries.text: Combat Feedback and Gameplay Clarity : Incoming hit audio is now clearer, rapid damage is easier to read, projectile and tracer behaviour is more consistent, and network warning indicators now provide better visibility during live combat.
heading: Major Updates for 1.2.3.0

entries.text: Weapons and Gadgets Receive a Broad Polish Pass : Defibrillators and the AJ-03 COAG Med Pen have been updated, while attachments, animations, unlock presentation, and challenge tracking have all seen further improvements.
heading: Major Updates for 1.2.3.0

entries.text: UI, HUD and Front-End Improvements : Menus, challenges, loadouts, End of Round screens, localisation, Store presentation, and Battle Pass readability have all been updated to improve clarity and consistency across the experience.
heading: Major Updates for 1.2.3.0

entries.text: Portal, AI, Audio and Settings Enhancements : Bot support has been expanded across Multiplayer and Operations, Portal tools and web app behaviour have been improved, audio has received further polish, and new controller tuning support has been added through the Deadzones Draw Tool.
heading: Major Updates for 1.2.3.0
